video_title: Will Hardy talks Jaxson Hayes, areas of improvement

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy on Utah's shooting struggles and physical play
quotes.excerpt: some nights when the shooting for us is this poor, it's easy to point at that
quotes.quote: It's a tough game. Obviously, a night where we couldn't really make a shot from it felt like anywhere. Makes the game hard. I thought first half got a lot of good looks. Thought the second half their physicality bothered us some. There's a lot to clean up, but some nights when the shooting for us is this poor, it's easy to point at that and say, oh, that's why we lost, you know, we missed a bunch of free throws and open threes. You know, our responsibility is to always know the difference between, hey, these parts we can't control, like the guys try to make every shot, there's no reason to sit there and yell, hey, make one, that's not impactful at all. But there are definitely things that are within our control, in particular tonight I thought it was our transition defense and our rebounding.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy on the Jazz shooting struggles tonight: There is a difference between shots not falling and things we can control like transition defense and rebounding. We have a lot to clean up.

structured.context: Will Hardy discusses the team's poor shooting performance and identifies transition defense and rebounding as areas for improvement.

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy praises Jaxson Hayes' recent performance and energy
quotes.excerpt: Jax, his energy, rebounding, his threat as a roller, I thought the team did a good job
quotes.quote: Yeah, he's been great. I think Jax, his energy, rebounding, his threat as a roller, I thought the team did a good job finding him in the pocket tonight. Plays around the basket on both sides. I think his lob threat has been big for our offense, and then defensively I think he gives us a good presence.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy on Jaxson Hayes: His energy, rebounding, and threat as a roller have been big for our offense. He gives us a good presence defensively.

structured.context: Will Hardy praises Jaxson Hayes for his energy, rebounding, and effectiveness as a lob threat in the recent game.

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy on the importance of quick decision-making
quotes.excerpt: it's everyone's responsibility to continue to try to make quick decisions
quotes.quote: Yeah, I thought there were plenty of possessions where the ball was sticky. It's everyone's responsibility to continue to try to make quick decisions.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy says the ball was sticky tonight and emphasizes that it is everyone's responsibility to continue to try to make quick decisions.

structured.context: Will Hardy emphasizes the need for players to make quicker decisions with the ball to avoid stagnant possessions.

quotes.speaker: Will Hardy
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Hardy identifies transition defense and rebounding as key areas for improvement
quotes.excerpt: I thought our transition defense and our rebounding is an area that we can improve
quotes.quote: I thought our transition defense and our rebounding is an area that we can improve. I do recognize that transition defense when you miss that many shots, there's a lot more opportunities for it. But I thought blocking out defensively is an area where tonight it got away from us a little bit. Offensively, I think we can continue to make quick decisions, trust the pass, trust the spacing.
quotes.social_post: Will Hardy identifies transition defense and rebounding as the key areas for the Jazz to improve after tonight's loss.

structured.context: Will Hardy reiterates the importance of improving transition defense, defensive rebounding, and offensive spacing.
